scheme_name: LEEP – Logistics Ease Across Different States
overview: LEEP – Logistics Ease Across Different States is a government initiative aimed at improving logistics efficiency and reducing costs across Indian states by identifying bottlenecks, streamlining procedures, and enhancing infrastructure coordination. The scheme focuses on creating a unified logistics ecosystem through policy reforms, digital integration, and stakeholder collaboration to boost trade competitiveness.
objectives: Reduce logistics costs and improve efficiency across states
Identify and address bottlenecks in the logistics value chain
Enhance coordination between central and state agencies
Promote digitalization and seamless movement of goods
Strengthen infrastructure planning and multimodal integration
Benchmark state-level logistics performance through LEEP index
eligibility: The scheme involves participation from state governments, logistics service providers, industry associations, and other stakeholders engaged in logistics and supply chain operations across India.
benefits: Improved logistics efficiency, reduced transit times and costs, enhanced supply chain reliability, better infrastructure utilization, data-driven policy insights, and increased competitiveness for businesses engaged in inter-state and international trade.
financial_support: LEEP does not provide direct financial support to entities; it is a policy and coordination framework focused on systemic improvements through governance, infrastructure planning, and regulatory harmonization.
application_process: LEEP does not have a traditional application process for beneficiaries; it operates through intergovernmental coordination, data collection from states, stakeholder consultations, and periodic assessment of logistics performance via the LEEP index.
deadlines: Rolling basis — assessments and updates are conducted periodically as part of ongoing logistics performance monitoring.
implementing_agency: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry
caveats: LEEP is a performance assessment and policy coordination tool, not a beneficiary-oriented scheme
Direct financial benefits or subsidies are not extended to individual entities under this initiative
Outcomes depend on state-level implementation and cooperation
